prs.title: fix(server): allow JSON Accept in JSON response mode
prs.author: Genmin
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: webStandardStreamableHttp.ts rejects POST requests with a 406 when the client's Accept header lists only `application/json` (without also listing `text/event-stream`), even though the transport is running in JSON response mode and never opens an SSE stream. Both PRs relax this same validation check in the same function. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: webStandardStreamableHttp.ts rejects POST requests with a 406 when the client's Accept header lists only `application/json` (without also listing `text/event-stream`), even though the transport is running in JSON response mode and never opens an SSE stream. Both PRs relax this same validation check in the same function. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 replaces the substring check with an `acceptsMediaType()` helper that does real Accept-header media-range parsing: it splits multiple entries, strips q-parameters, explicitly rejects entries with `q=0`, and supports wildcard matches (`*/*`, `application/*`). #2046's fix is a plain `acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')` check, which would incorrectly accept a client sending `application/json;q=0` (an explicit decline) and won't match wildcard Accept headers. Same underlying bug, but #1996's implementation covers more of the cases a real Accept header can express.

members.cluster_pick_reason: Both add src/index.ts re-exporting types.js and inMemory.js, but #2030 additionally does `export * from './client/index.js'` and `export * from './server/index.js'` in the same barrel. #2523's own code comment flags that combining those two subpaths triggers TS2308 (ambiguous re-export) because client and server modules re-export identically-named symbols — a tsc/type-check failure that #2030's vitest-based test wouldn't catch, since vitest transpiles without full type-checking and only exercises runtime behavior. #2523 also ships the required .changeset entry for versioning and cites the tracking issue number, while #2030 has neither. #2523's approach (root exports limited to types + inMemory, Client/Server kept on their existing subpaths) is the safer, more likely-to-compile fix for the same missing-file problem.

clusters.pick_reason: #2215 includes the same regex-based trailing-slash normalization in buildWellKnownPath as #2214 (functionally equivalent fix), but additionally corrects the shouldAttemptFallback() root-path check (pathname === '/' → '') via a shared normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper, fixing a redundant-network-request bug that #2214 (labeled chore, no behavioral fix) does not address. Note: #2214 also fixes the same duplicated slash-stripping logic inside buildDiscoveryUrls(), which #2215's diff does not touch — that spot should be re-verified/ported over after #2214 is closed.
